shadow-shield.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

shadow-tag.name: Shadow Tag
shadow-tag.shortDesc: Prevents foes from choosing to switch unless they also have this Ability.

sharpness.name: Sharpness
sharpness.shortDesc: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.shortDesc: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its status cured at the end of each turn.

sheer-force.name: Sheer Force
sheer-force.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have 1.3x power; nullifies the effects.

shell-armor.name: Shell Armor
shell-armor.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

shield-dust.name: Shield Dust
shield-dust.shortDesc: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack.

shields-down.name: Shields Down
shields-down.shortDesc: If Minior, switch-in/end of turn it changes to Core at 1/2 max HP or less, else Meteor.

simple.name: Simple
simple.shortDesc: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages is raised or lowered, the amount is doubled.

skill-link.name: Skill Link
skill-link.shortDesc: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times.

slow-start.name: Slow Start
slow-start.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon's Attack and Speed are halved for 5 turns.

slush-rush.name: Slush Rush
slush-rush.shortDesc: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.shortDesc: If this Pokemon strikes with a critical hit, the damage is multiplied by 1.5.

snow-cloak.name: Snow Cloak
snow-cloak.shortDesc: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's evasiveness is 1.25x.

snow-warning.name: Snow Warning
snow-warning.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

solar-power.name: Solar Power
solar-power.shortDesc: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Sp. Atk is 1.5x; loses 1/8 max HP per turn.

solid-rock.name: Solid Rock
solid-rock.shortDesc: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

soul-heart.name: Soul-Heart

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.shortDesc: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.

speed-boost.name: Speed Boost
speed-boost.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised 1 stage at the end of each full turn on the field.

spicy-spray.name: Spicy Spray
spicy-spray.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the attacker becomes burned.

stakeout.name: Stakeout

stall.name: Stall
stall.shortDesc: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.

stance-change.name: Stance Change

static.name: Static
static.shortDesc: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.shortDesc: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.

steam-engine.name: Steam Engine
steam-engine.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by Fire/Water moves.

steelworker.name: Steelworker
steelworker.shortDesc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Steel-type attack.

steely-spirit.name: Steely Spirit
steely-spirit.shortDesc: This Pokemon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

stench.name: Stench

sticky-hold.name: Sticky Hold

storm-drain.name: Storm Drain

strong-jaw.name: Strong Jaw

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. Immune to OHKO.

suction-cups.name: Suction Cups
suction-cups.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokemon's attack or item.

super-luck.name: Super Luck
super-luck.shortDesc: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.

supersweet-syrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweet-syrup.shortDesc: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.

supreme-overlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supreme-overlord.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves have 10% more power for each fainted ally, up to 5 allies.

surge-surfer.name: Surge Surfer

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Bug attacks.

sweet-veil.name: Sweet Veil

swift-swim.name: Swift Swim

sword-of-ruin.name: Sword of Ruin

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis

synchronize.name: Synchronize

tablets-of-ruin.name: Tablets of Ruin
tablets-of-ruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75.

tangled-feet.name: Tangled Feet

tangling-hair.name: Tangling Hair

technician.name: Technician

telepathy.name: Telepathy

tera-shell.name: Tera Shell

tera-shift.name: Tera Shift

teraform-zero.name: Teraform Zero
teraform-zero.shortDesc: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.

teravolt.name: Teravolt
teravolt.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

thermal-exchange.name: Thermal Exchange
thermal-exchange.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 when damaged by Fire moves; can't be burned.

thick-fat.name: Thick Fat
thick-fat.shortDesc: Fire-/Ice-type moves against this Pokemon deal damage with a halved offensive stat.

tinted-lens.name: Tinted Lens
tinted-lens.shortDesc: This Pokemon's attacks that are not very effective on a target deal double damage.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.shortDesc: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Water attacks.

tough-claws.name: Tough Claws
tough-claws.shortDesc: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.

toxic-boost.name: Toxic Boost
toxic-boost.shortDesc: While this Pokemon is poisoned, its physical attacks have 1.5x power.

toxic-chain.name: Toxic Chain

toxic-debris.name: Toxic Debris
toxic-debris.shortDesc: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.

trace.name: Trace

transistor.name: Transistor
transistor.shortDesc: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.

triage.name: Triage
triage.shortDesc: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

truant.name: Truant

turboblaze.name: Turboblaze
turboblaze.shortDesc: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

unaware.name: Unaware

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.shortDesc: Speed is doubled on held item loss; boost is lost if it switches, gets new item/Ability.

unnerve.name: Unnerve

unseen-fist.name: Unseen Fist
unseen-fist.shortDesc: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.

vessel-of-ruin.name: Vessel of Ruin
vessel-of-ruin.shortDesc: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.

victory-star.name: Victory Star

vital-spirit.name: Vital Spirit

volt-absorb.name: Volt Absorb

wandering-spirit.name: Wandering Spirit

water-absorb.name: Water Absorb

water-bubble.name: Water Bubble

water-compaction.name: Water Compaction
water-compaction.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.

water-veil.name: Water Veil
water-veil.shortDesc: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

weak-armor.name: Weak Armor
weak-armor.shortDesc: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, Defense is lowered by 1, Speed is raised by 2.

well-baked-body.name: Well-Baked Body
well-baked-body.shortDesc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages if hit by a Fire move; Fire immunity.

white-smoke.name: White Smoke

wimp-out.name: Wimp Out

wind-power.name: Wind Power

wind-rider.name: Wind Rider
wind-rider.shortDesc: Attack raised by 1 if hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins. Wind move immunity.

wonder-guard.name: Wonder Guard
wonder-guard.shortDesc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.

wonder-skin.name: Wonder Skin
wonder-skin.shortDesc: Status moves with accuracy checks are 50% accurate when used on this Pokemon.

zen-mode.name: Zen Mode
zen-mode.shortDesc: If Darmanitan, at end of turn changes Mode to Standard if > 1/2 max HP, else Zen.

zero-to-hero.name: Zero to Hero
